recent_articles.title: ‘Not just about giving money’: Lokesh pledges long-term support for steel blast families - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **IT Minister Nara Lokesh** and **Union Minister for Steel H. D. Kumaraswamy** visited the Visakhapatnam Steel Plant (VSP) following a recent blast, where they announced immediate financial compensation of ₹25 lakh to families of the victims.  The government is committed to securing the future of the affected families, including providing education and welfare support for their children. **Mr. Lokesh** also highlighted the NDA government's swift response to the incident, emphasizing continuous monitoring by senior ministers and the announcement of permanent employment for one member from each affected family. Workers expressed concern about the plant's future, particularly regarding potential privatization, while **Mr. Lokesh** assured them that the government is committed to safeguarding VSP.

recent_articles.title: Not Just Bullet Train, Centre Has Big Railway Development Plans For Bengal
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw** and **West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari** met to discuss key railway projects for the state.  **Vaishnaw** announced 61 railway projects, including 538 new flyovers and underpasses, 102 'Amrit Bharat' stations, 60 new Kolkata Metro rakes, and a bullet train service between Siliguri and Delhi. The projects are estimated to cost Rs 1 lakh crore and will be funded by the government.  **Adhikari** expressed hope that these projects will benefit the people of West Bengal.

recent_articles.title: Rs 1 lakh crore rail overhaul for Bengal: Vaishnaw, CM Adhikari review status of ongoing projects | Kolkata News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw** and **Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari** announced plans to overhaul the state's railway network, with over Rs 1 lakh crore worth of projects set for implementation. The projects include redeveloping 102 stations as "Amrit Bharat stations" and constructing 538 flyovers and underpasses to ease traffic congestion. **Vaishnaw** praised Adhikari for the BJP's victory in the state, while **Adhikari** pledged cooperation between the state government and the Centre on railway projects.  The meeting aimed to address delays caused by land acquisition issues and project clearances.

recent_articles.title: Sixty next-generation trains to be introduced for Kolkata Metro in 5 years: Vaishnaw - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw** announced plans to introduce 60 next-generation trains for the Kolkata Metro over the next five years, aiming to revitalize railway projects in West Bengal. **Vaishnaw**, who visited the state secretariat Nabanna with **Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari**, highlighted the progress made since 2014, including the addition of 45 km of metro lines. He also discussed proposed bullet train services between Delhi–Varanasi and Varanasi–Siliguri, which aim to reduce travel time significantly.

recent_articles.title: Cabinet Approves Rs 10,000-Crore Fund Amid Rising Jet Fuel Prices
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Indian** government approved a Rs 10,000 crore aviation fuel price stabilization fund to mitigate the impact of rising global prices.  Information Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that the fund will help stabilize aviation turbine fuel (ATF) prices for airlines and prevent disruptions in operations. The fund is expected to protect 77 lakh jobs dependent on the aviation ecosystem and safeguard public investment in airport infrastructure. It will be in effect for 36 months, with annual reviews or until the advance amount is fully recovered/settled.

recent_articles.title: Railways Ministry nod sought for ₹422 crore Mysuru railway station upgrade - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yaduveer Krishnadatta Chamaraja Wadiyar**, **Mysuru MP**, urged the **Ministry of Railways** to approve the ₹422-crore redevelopment of Mysuru railway station, including a third entry terminal.  He also requested the extension of the proposed Chennai high-speed rail corridor to Mysuru during a meeting with Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw in New Delhi. The MP emphasized the need for increased investment in railway infrastructure due to Mysuru's growing economic and passenger traffic.

recent_articles.title: Satish Sharma meets Union Railway Minister, seeks Rajouri-Poonch rail link
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Satish Sharma**, Minister for Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs, Information Technology, Transport, Youth Services & Sports, and Science & Technology of **Jammu and Kashmir**, met with **Ashwini Vaishnaw**, Union Minister for Railways, Information and Broadcasting, Electronics & Information Technology.  Sharma urged the Union Railway Minister to prioritize a proposed rail corridor connecting Jammu–Akhnoor–Dori Dager–Sunderbani–Nowshera–Rajouri–Poonch, highlighting its strategic, economic, and social significance for the region's residents. Sharma emphasized the project's importance for national security due to the border districts' sensitive international location and stressed the need for a feasibility study and budgetary provisions for implementation.  The Union Railway Minister assured Sharma that the concerns raised would be considered sympathetically.

recent_articles.title: TDP leverages technology in organising hybrid Mahanadu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Telugu Desam Party (TDP)** held its virtual Mahanadu 2026, a hybrid event with over seven lakh cadres participating. The two-day conclave featured a timer for speeches and utilized technology to manage the organization. **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** delivered his presidential message to participants across the state, utilizing a GPS-enabled digital invitation system and a central command-and-control center.  The event aimed to be cost-efficient and inclusive by leveraging technology.

recent_articles.title: Raichur MP raises concern over proposed Information Technology Act amendments - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **G. Kumar Naik**, a member of the **Parliamentary Standing Committee on Communication and Information Technology**, has urged **Ashwini Vaishnaw**, Union Minister for Electronics and Information Technology, to reconsider certain provisions in the draft Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Second Amendment Rules 2026.  **Naik** expressed concerns that the proposed amendments could impact democratic participation, free expression, and Constitutional safeguards by expanding the scope of Part III of the rules and enabling direct Ministry referrals to an Inter-Departmental Committee without a complaint from an aggrieved party. He also raised objections to linking intermediary safe harbor protections under Section 79 of the Information Technology Act 2000 to compliance with government advisories, clarifications, and standard operating procedures.  **Naik** emphasized the importance of balancing platform accountability and online safety with Constitutional guarantees of free expression and independent oversight in India's evolving digital governance framework.

recent_articles.title: Cabinet approves four more judges for Supreme Court - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Union Cabinet** approved an increase in the number of Supreme Court judges from 34 to 38, a move aimed at addressing the ongoing backlog of cases.  The amendment will be introduced in Parliament and requires approval from the **Parliament**. The current backlog stands at 92,385 cases, with several judges scheduled to retire this year. This decision follows a six-year hiatus since the last increase in 2019.

recent_articles.title: Renowned lyricist Prasoon Joshi appointed Prasar Bharati Chairman - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prasoon Joshi**, a renowned lyricist and writer, has been appointed Chairman of **Prasar Bharati** by the **Ministry of Information and Broadcasting**.  Mr. Vaishnaw expressed confidence in Mr. Joshi's ability to lead Prasar Bharati through technological transformation and evolving audience expectations. Mr. Joshi previously served as Chairperson of the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) and holds various other prominent positions within the creative industries.

recent_articles.title: Telangana IT Minister for stronger digital push in govt. schools - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D. Sridhar Babu**, Minister for IT and Industries, visited a 'Super Summer Camp' in Manthani town to support the development of digital infrastructure in government schools. The camp, organized by **T-Fiber** and **Super Teacher Edu Reforms Pvt. Ltd.** aims to bridge the digital divide and provide hands-on learning experiences in computer education, AI, and robotics for students. Similar camps will be held in Peddapalli, Ramagundam, and Sulthanabad until May 23rd with a closing ceremony scheduled for May 26th.

recent_articles.title: Railways Minister flags off first Jammu-Srinagar direct train service on ‘historic day’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Union Minister for Railways Ashwini Vaishnaw** and **J&K Chief Minister Omar Abdullah** celebrated the launch of the first direct train service between Jammu city and Srinagar city.  Vaishnaw described the service as a "gamechanger" for the region's economy, highlighting its impact on cargo movement and tourism. The new rail line connects the Kashmir division with the Jammu division, offering seamless travel to pilgrimage destinations like Shree Mata Vaishno Devi and Shri Amarnath temple. **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** is credited with realizing the dream of railway connectivity in the Kashmir Valley.

recent_articles.title: Chandrababu Naidu lays foundation for Google’s ₹1.35 lakh crore AI data centre in Visakhapatnam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** laid the foundation stone for a 1-Gigawatt Google data center in Tarluvada, Visakhapatnam, marking one of India's largest foreign direct investments. The project will be managed by **Google’s subsidiary Raiden Infotech**, in partnership with **Adani Infra**, and is part of a $15 billion investment from **Google** in the state.  The center will offer large-scale data storage and AI cloud infrastructure, and an upcoming subsea cable system will connect Visakhapatnam to several countries. Union Ministers, IT Minister Nara Lokesh, and representatives from Google, Adani Group, and Airtel Nxtra attended the ceremony.

recent_articles.title: Chandrababu Naidu lays foundation for Google’s ₹1.35 lakh crore AI data centre in Visakhapatnam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: On Tuesday, April 28, 2026, **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** laid the foundation stone for a Google data center in Tarluvada, Visakhapatnam. The $15 billion investment will create a 1-Gigawatt hyperscale AI data center on 601.4 acres and is expected to generate thousands of jobs. **Union Ministers Ashwini Vaishnaw**, **Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu**, and **Pemmasani Chandrasekhar**, along with **IT Minister Nara Lokesh** and representatives from Google, Adani Infra, and other partners attended the ceremony.  The project will be inaugurated in September 2028 and is expected to position Andhra Pradesh as an international data gateway for India.

recent_articles.title: Children with Special Needs from State-run schools in Andhra Pradesh scale Everest Base Camp, set national benchmark - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Twenty-one children with special needs** from government schools in Andhra Pradesh successfully completed the Everest Base Camp trek in Nepal. The 16-day expedition, organized by **Samagra Shiksha**, Andhra Pradesh, and supported by the School Education Department, marked the first government-sponsored Everest Base Camp trek for specially-abled students.  The students, accompanied by mountaineers and officials, demonstrated their determination to overcome social stigma and achieve their goals. **Nara Lokesh**, HRD Minister and IT Minister of Andhra Pradesh, congratulated the students on their success and highlighted the importance of inclusivity in education.

recent_articles.title: Telangana IT Minister Sridhar Babu calls for stricter curbs against gutka, pan masala, khaini and drugs in State - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Duddilla Sridhar Babu**, **Telangana IT Minister**, warned against the consumption of gutka, pan masala, khaini, and narcotics, emphasizing their serious health risks. He urged young people to avoid addiction and adopt healthier lifestyles during an Oral Cancer Awareness Marathon in Hyderabad organized by the **Global Oral Cancer Trust**.  **Cyberabad Police Commissioner M. Ramesh** also participated in the event, flagging off a 5K run.

recent_articles.title: Lokesh inaugurates cricket stadium built at ₹10-cr. cost in Tirupati - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nara Lokesh**, the Human Resource Development and IT Minister, inaugurated two new sports facilities in Tirupati district. The **Nandamuri Taraka Rama Rao cricket stadium** and **Nara Ramamurthy Naidu Kreeda Vikasa Kendram** were built at a combined cost of ₹13.27 crore and aim to enhance sports infrastructure in the region. Lokesh announced a 90-day action plan to prioritize sports development, including creating fitness facilities for school children and utilizing existing sports quota jobs to improve the sector. He also met with several prominent athletes from various disciplines.

recent_articles.title: Bengaluru–Mumbai Vande Bharat sleeper train gets approval - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw** has approved the introduction of a **Vande Bharat sleeper train service** between KSR Bengaluru and Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus in Mumbai. The **South Western Railway (SWR)** will run and maintain the semi-high-speed train, which is expected to enhance overnight travel between the two cities. This will be the second Vande Bharat sleeper train in India, following the first service launched in January 2026 between Howrah and Kamakhya.

recent_articles.title: KTR showcases Telangana growth model at Columbia Business School - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K.T. Rama Rao**, working president of the **Bharatiya Rashtra Samithi (BRS)**, lauded **Telangana’s** rapid economic and technological transformation during a speech at the 21st Annual India Business Conference in New York.  He emphasized that the state's success was due to its clear leadership under **K. Chandrasekhar Rao**, highlighting Telangana's growth in IT exports, employment in the technology sector, and investment in innovation infrastructure. He also pointed out the state's contributions to life sciences, including vaccine production and biotech innovation.

recent_articles.title: Kerala’s wait for high-speed rail to linger on - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Despite election promises from various political fronts in Kerala, the **Union government** has no immediate plans for a high-speed rail project.  The **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)** manifesto proposes a green high-speed railway network connecting Thiruvananthapuram to Kannur, while the **Left Democratic Front (LDF)** and **United Democratic Alliance (UDF)** have pledged continued efforts towards a north-south route. The **Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw** stated that the focus will be on enhancing existing rail networks' speed potential through additional lines.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka Minister M.B. Patil writes to Centre seeking express train between Bengaluru and Vijayapura - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Karnataka's Infrastructure Development Minister M.B. Patil** has requested **Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw** and **Minister of State for Railways V. Somanna** to introduce a long-pending express train service between Bengaluru and Vijayapura, citing the completion of the Almatti–Wandal double line railway section.  Patil's request follows an earlier meeting where it was suggested that once the project is finished, an express train could be introduced. He also asked for trains from Bengaluru to Vijayapura to have limited stops up to Hubballi and to be routed via the Hubballi and Gadag bypass line to reduce travel time.

recent_articles.title: A sidetracked railway in Visakhapatnam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Despite the **Railway Board**'s announcement of the new South Coast Railway (SCoR) zone in 2019, progress has been slow. The lack of a Gazette notification to officially establish the zone has stalled operations and raised concerns about the government's commitment.  The delay has led to accusations from BJP leaders that Visakhapatnam is being unfairly treated by the **East Coast Railway (ECoR)** while also hindering the development of the Waltair division, which is crucial for Andhra Pradesh's economic growth.

recent_articles.title: Ministry of Railways regularises four express trains from Kakinada city - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Ministry of Railways** has regularized four special train services between Kakinada city and four destinations, including Mysore, Lingampalli, Hisur. **Minister of Railways Ashwani Vaishnaw** confirmed the change to daily service operations in a letter to **Kakinada MP Tangella Uday Srinivas**, who anticipates the new routes becoming operational in April.

recent_articles.title: Bihar’s youth now making their mark in technology field: IT Minister Shreyasi Singh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bihar’s** Information Technology Minister Shreyasi Singh highlighted the state's growing talent pool in technology, emphasizing the potential of its youth.  She praised **IIT Patna’s** Incubation Centre for fostering innovation and signed MOUs with **AIIMS Patna** and JHPIEGO. The government is actively developing a strong startup ecosystem through initiatives like a "plug-and-play" workspace at Biscomaun Tower and Software Technology Parks in Darbhanga and Bhagalpur.  Singh encouraged young innovators to pursue ambitious goals, fostering technological solutions for societal challenges.

recent_articles.title: Ready to release White Paper on investment scenario, says Sridhar Babu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D. Sridhar Babu**, **Industries and IT Minister of Telangana**, announced his readiness to release a White Paper detailing investment scenarios in the state, including signed Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with companies, potential investments, and companies showing interest. He refuted Opposition claims about investment stagnation, emphasizing the government's efforts to attract businesses and generate employment.  He also highlighted the importance of global platforms like the World Economic Forum for attracting investments and acknowledged that MoUs require due diligence before implementation.

recent_articles.title: India raises clean-energy ambition with 60% non-fossil fuel power goal by 2035 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** has updated its Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) to reach 60% non-fossil fuel capacity in electricity by 2035, reduce emissions intensity per unit of GDP by 47%, and increase its carbon sink to 3.5 billion tonnes - 4 billion tonnes.  The **Union Information Technology Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw** stated that India will achieve these goals quickly due to the speed at which it is expanding non-fossil sources. The NDC, submitted to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), was announced following a Cabinet meeting and aligns with the Paris Agreement's objectives.  India joins other G20 countries in committing to ambitious climate action despite pressure from developed nations who are rolling back climate policies and trade measures.

recent_articles.title: Cabinet extends immigration, visa tracking system for another five years - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Union Cabinet** approved the continuation of the Immigration, Visa, Foreigners Registration & Tracking (IVFRT) Scheme for five years until 2031 with a budget of ₹1,800 crore. The scheme aims to modernize the immigration and visa ecosystem by adopting emerging technologies like mobile-based services and self-service kiosks.  The project was first approved in 2010 and seeks to expand and strengthen existing infrastructure nationwide. **Ashwini Vaishnaw**, Union Minister, stated that the scheme will address emerging challenges in immigration control and foreigner management, including illegal migration.

recent_articles.title: Centre launches AI skilling drive with Google, YouTube - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw** unveiled three new initiatives aimed at strengthening India's media, broadcasting, and digital sectors. The initiatives include the National AI Skilling Initiative in partnership with **Google** and YouTube through the Indian Institute of Creative Technologies (IICT), MyWAVES, a citizen creator platform on WAVES OTT, and the rollout of advanced Electronic Programme Guide (EPG) and in-built satellite tuners in television sets for enhanced access to DD Free Dish services. The event was attended by key media and entertainment industry representatives and **YouTube India managing director Gunjan Soni**.  **Vaishnaw** emphasized the government's commitment to promoting the "Orange Economy" and supporting the creative sector, highlighting the importance of democratizing technology through these initiatives.

recent_articles.title: Cabinet approves ₹33,660 crore BHAVYA scheme to accelerate industrial development - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Indian government approved a ₹33,660 crore scheme called Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojna (BHAVYA) to develop 100 plug-and-play industrial parks across the country.**  **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, who chaired the Cabinet meeting, stated that the aim is to develop world-class infrastructure and unlock manufacturing potential. The scheme will generate approximately 15 lakh direct jobs and provide financial support of up to ₹1 crore per acre for industrial parks ranging in size from 100 to 1,000 acres.
